exam_name: Microsoft Dynamics 365: Finance and Operations Apps Solution Architect

testing_centers.notes: Available at Certiport Authorized Testing Centers (primarily academic)

id_requirements: One valid, government-issued photo ID. Name on ID must match registration. For online: webcam required, room must be clear of people and materials.
exam_rules: No notes, books, or study materials. No phones or smartwatches. Whiteboard or scratch paper may be provided by testing center. Online: no dual monitors, no virtual machines, no headphones, must be alone in a closed room.
renewal_options: Microsoft certifications (Associate/Expert/Specialty) are renewed annually for free via a short renewal assessment on Microsoft Learn. Renewal assessment available 6 months before expiry. Fundamentals certifications do not expire.
target_audience: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance, Supply Chain Management, and Commerce professionals who advise stakeholders and translate business requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable solutions
recommended_experience: Knowledge of the Dynamics 365 ecosystem and Microsoft Power Platform. Deep understanding of finance and operations apps, and Copilot and AI agents used in the finance and operations apps. Extensive domain knowledge in one or more industry verticals

retake_policy.notes: No waiting period for first retake if score >= 500 on failed attempt. If score < 500: 14-day waiting period before retake. Maximum 5 attempts per exam per year (365 days). Free retake voucher sometimes included in official instructor-led training.

editorial.meta_description: MB-700 is retired. Compare its historical blueprint with AB-100, see what transfers, and rebuild your plan around the current Microsoft exam.
editorial.overview: MB-700 was Microsoft's Microsoft Dynamics 365: Finance and Operations Apps Solution Architect exam until its retirement on 2026-06-30. Its final published scope covered Architect solutions, Define solution strategies, Manage implementations, Manage testing. This page preserves that dated outline for historical comparison and curriculum cleanup. It is not a schedulable exam, and its prices, delivery details, registration links, and practice calls to action must not be used for a new certification plan.
editorial.who_should_take: Nobody should start a new certification plan around MB-700. This page serves former candidates, credential holders, training teams removing stale material, and practitioners deciding whether prior preparation is reusable for AB-100. New candidates should verify the active Microsoft page and current dated study guide before booking.

editorial.preparation_strategy: Do not rename an old MB-700 checklist or question bank as AB-100. Compare the two official guides objective by objective and classify each historical skill as transferable, changed, or absent. Use transferable experience as a diagnostic baseline, then rebuild labs and review around AB-100's current domain weights, products, role expectations, security controls, and operational tasks. Because Microsoft identifies AB-100 as the broader replacement path, review the skill map below before assuming equivalence.

domain_guidance.summary: Historically, Architect solutions required candidates to connect configuration choices with operational outcomes. The official outline included Gather requirements; Define the solution architecture. Preserve hands-on understanding of those tasks where the successor comparison shows overlap, but do not treat this retired weighting or terminology as a current exam blueprint.

methodology.summary: Cert Atlas compared Microsoft's final MB-700 study guide with the current AB-100 guide at the domain and objective level, then checked Microsoft's retirement list and transition announcement. OpenAI Codex assisted with extraction, normalization, comparison, and drafting. Claims were reviewed against the linked official sources; no exam stems, answers, choices, or explanations were used.

lifecycle.summary: Microsoft retired MB-700 and the Finance and Operations Apps Solution Architect Expert certification on June 30, 2026. Microsoft lists AB-100 as a collective replacement for MB-700 and several other retired business application credentials.
migration_actions: Stop scheduling, selling, or presenting MB-700 as a current exam.
Compare completed MB-700 preparation with the current AB-100 guide; do not carry over obsolete weighting or mechanics.
Create a fresh AB-100 plan around its current domains and hands-on role expectations.
Remove or quarantine practice content that cannot be mapped to a current objective with source evidence.
Recheck Microsoft's dated AB-100 study guide before booking because role-based exams change over time.

skill_comparison.change: Architecture judgment transfers, while AB-100 adds agentic patterns, model choices, orchestration, grounding, and AI-specific controls.
Strategic discovery remains important but is reframed around AI value, readiness, responsible use, data, and adoption.
The replacement increases deployment weight and adds evaluation, observability, governance, security, and lifecycle management for agents.
